description: This file provides utilities for NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) system support in PyTorch, including classes, functions, and logic for binding processes and threads to specific CPU cores based on NUMA topology and GPU placement.

classes.name: AffinityMode
classes.description: Enumeration of different CPU affinity binding modes for NUMA systems.

classes.name: NumaOptions
classes.description: Data class encapsulating options for NUMA binding behavior, including affinity mode and fallback behavior.

methods.name: _maybe_wrap_command_args_with_numa_binding
methods.description: Wraps command-line arguments with numactl for NUMA CPU binding based on GPU index and options.

methods.name: _maybe_wrap_with_numa_binding
methods.description: Decorator to apply NUMA CPU affinity to a function before execution.

methods.name: _maybe_apply_numa_binding_to_current_process
methods.description: Applies NUMA binding to the current process's threads based on GPU index and options.

methods.name: _assemble_numactl_command_args
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments for numactl with specified CPU ranges.

methods.name: _handle_exception
methods.description: Handles exceptions during NUMA binding, logs events, and optionally falls back.

methods.name: _get_validated_logical_cpus_to_bind_to
methods.description: Retrieves and validates logical CPU indices for binding based on GPU and NUMA options.

methods.name: _raise_if_binding_invalid
methods.description: Checks if the CPU binding set is valid and raises errors if not.

methods.name: _bind_all_threads_in_current_process_to_logical_cpus
methods.description: Sets CPU affinity for all threads in the current process to specified logical CPUs.

methods.name: _get_logical_cpus_to_bind_to
methods.description: Determines logical CPU indices to bind to based on affinity mode.

methods.name: _node_get_logical_cpus_to_bind_to
methods.description: Core logic for 'node' NUMA binding mode, binding to CPUs in the NUMA node of a GPU.

methods.name: _socket_get_logical_cpus_to_bind_to
methods.description: Core logic for 'socket' NUMA binding mode, binding to CPUs in the socket containing the GPU.

methods.name: _exclusive_get_logical_cpus_to_bind_to
methods.description: Core logic for 'exclusive' NUMA binding mode, dividing CPUs evenly among GPUs on a NUMA node.

methods.name: _core_complex_get_logical_cpus_to_bind_to
methods.description: Core logic for 'core-complex' NUMA binding mode, binding to a full core complex sharing an L3 cache.

methods.name: _group_by
methods.description: Utility to group iterable elements by a key function into a dictionary of sets.

methods.name: _get_logical_cpu_indices_sharing_same_physical_core_as
methods.description: Finds CPUs sharing the same physical core as a given logical CPU.

methods.name: _get_logical_cpus_sharing_same_max_level_cache_as
methods.description: Finds CPUs sharing the same maximum level cache as a given logical CPU.

methods.name: _get_allowed_logical_cpu_indices_for_numa_node
methods.description: Returns allowed logical CPUs for a NUMA node, intersected with current thread's allowed CPUs.

methods.name: _get_cpu_indices_for_numa_node_MAYBE_NOT_ALLOWED
methods.description: Returns all CPU indices associated with a NUMA node, unfiltered.

methods.name: _get_gpu_count
methods.description: Returns the number of GPUs available via torch.cuda.

methods.name: _get_numa_node_index_for_gpu_index
methods.description: Determines the NUMA node index for a given GPU index.

methods.name: _get_gpu_indices_for_numa_node
methods.description: Returns GPU indices associated with a specific NUMA node.

methods.name: _get_socket_index_for_numa_node
methods.description: Determines socket index for a NUMA node.

methods.name: _get_socket_index_for_cpu
methods.description: Determines socket index for a CPU core.

methods.name: _get_arbitrary_allowed_cpu_index_for_numa_node
methods.description: Selects an arbitrary CPU index allowed in a NUMA node.

methods.name: _get_set_of_int_from_ranges_str
methods.description: Parses a string of integer ranges into a set of integers.

methods.name: _get_ranges_str_from_ints
methods.description: Converts a set of integers into a compact range string.

methods.name: _get_systemwide_numa_node_indices
methods.description: Returns all possible NUMA node indices in the system.

methods.name: _get_numa_node_indices_for_socket_index
methods.description: Returns NUMA nodes associated with a socket index.

methods.name: _get_allowed_cpu_indices_for_current_thread
methods.description: Returns CPU indices allowed for the current thread.
